title: Conjecture on convexity and concavity of the Arimoto information-combining bound
statement:
Let $k_\alpha^A$ denote the Arimoto conditional-entropy function and let $\ast$ denote binary convolution. There exists a value $1<\hat\alpha<1.5783$ such that

$$
k_{\alpha}^A\left({k_{\alpha}^A}^{-1}(x)\ast {k_{\alpha}^A}^{-1}(y)\right)
$$

is convex for $0<\alpha<1$ and concave for $1<\alpha\leq\hat\alpha$. This conjecture is based on numerical evidence; the stated threshold is bounded by verified counterexamples and additional numerical observations, while the behavior beyond $\hat\alpha$ is not asserted.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2004.14408

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of April 2020).
source_name: Christoph Hirche, “Rényi Bounds on Information Combining”, arXiv:2004.14408 (2020).
